prs.title: test(punycode): improve automated test coverage and mutation score
prs.body:
## Summary

This PR improves the automated test suite for `src/punycode.ts` by enhancing test cases and configuration to increase mutation coverage and maintain high code coverage.

## Changes

- Updated `test/punycode.mac-cov.test.ts` with improved test scenarios.
- Adjusted `.ijst-stryker.config.json` for better mutation testing configuration.
- Updated reports to reflect new metrics.

## Metrics

| Metric | Before | After | Change |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Coverage** | 95.23% | 95.23% | 0.00% |
| **Mutation Score** | 74.16% | 74.72% | +0.56% |
| **MAC** | 70.62 | 71.16 | +0.54 |

## Checklist

- [x] Tests added/updated
- [x] Metrics improved
- [x] No breaking changes

constraints: Read AGENTS.md immediately after cloning to determine behavior rules
Use npm, yarn, pnpm, or bun for package installation
Support ESM, CommonJS, and Deno import styles
Ensure decode functions return original text on failure
Implement strict mode for parseFilename to require file extensions
Handle defaultProto in parseURL for protocol-less inputs
Encode query keys to include the equals sign
Encode query values to handle plus encoding consistency
post_clone.notes: Constraints derived from README installation instructions, API signatures, and specific behavioral notes for parsing and encoding utilities.

pre_pick.notes: Create separate branch per file for test improvement

constraints: don't use introspection; follow the existing test style

pick_file.reason: Pure logic module with the lowest coverage and unmeasured mutation score, making it the weakest candidate for test improvement.

check_changes.reason: MAC improved and suite is green as required by the team rule.
